title: neltuma piurensis
intro: Neltuma piurensis, commonly known as Piure, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Neltuma piurensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce pain and fever, as well as its use in treating various health conditions such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Neltuma piurensis include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
